common.universe: ALL retained issuer reports for AXTI,CRWV,FOSL,SNDK,LFST,GCT,BB,OSCR,KNSA; chosen by existing source availability, not subsequent returns. Includes weak/no-event cases. Convenience population is not unbiased and produces no prevalence/return estimate.
common.entry: Research-only: first regular-session open after event is actually public and clock verified; expires after that session. A halt/missing executable entry is a no-fill/UNKNOWN, never rolled forward to a later winner.
common.exit: Fixed stated session close (entry=1); no discretionary stop/exit repair. Halt/delisting exit unresolved, no last-mark invented execution. No existing rule is changed or adopted.
common.cost: One whole-share buy/sell,$1000reference,reserve$3each executed side,spread/slippage/gaps/halts/no-fill explicit. No USD/BBO evidence => NULL executable result.
common.comparisons: Original announcement/revenue-only/low-debt-value matched controls by mechanism, sector/market, unaffected source cases; untouched controls are not built from future winners. None is claimed available merely from a case study.
common.sample: Chronological development/validation/future untouched cohort required; retained illustrative sources are exploratory and already known. No fresh confirmation/p-values or historical ZAD inference.
common.noveltyCheck: No exact ID found in824 library IDs. Nearest economic neighbors named. Lexical absence is not proof universal novelty. Independent challenge required before any returns test.
common.authority: No market calls, production actions, workflow runs, source promotion, new collection or live rules. Source reading only on retained originals; no blind strategy deployment.

questions.question: Does first verified fulfillment plus a cash receipt on the SAME identified customer contract add information beyond its announcement/backlog?
questions.novelty: Not another 1.01 keyword/size or RPO-growth filter: event must identify performance and contract-specific cash, not generic company CFO. No claim all related economic ideas are new.
questions.entryEvent: First original issuer/regulator disclosure explicitly linking an identified binding customer contract, completed/accepted delivery and actual issuer cash receipt for that contract; financing principal/equity/nonbinding ceilings do not count. Named counterpart identity must be established, not inferred from industry.
questions.falsification: No effect beyond contract-announcement/earnings/sector controls, mixed financing taxonomy, non-executable gaps or adverse after-cost outcomes.

questions.family: Firm pricing power and inventory economics
questions.question: Does disclosed unit-price improvement with nondeclining unit shipments carry incremental information beyond inventory cuts or total revenue growth?
questions.novelty: Uses separately disclosed price and quantity for one product, not an inventory percentile, share-price momentum or headline demand. ASP including mix is a proxy and must be labeled; it does not establish pure pricing power.
questions.entryEvent: First original quarterly release/filing with positive QoQ issuer-reported unit-price/ASP change and nonnegative same-product unit/bit shipment change; same period/basis required. No missing quantity imputation; mix/FX effects remain explicit.
questions.falsification: Mix rather than pricing explains reported ASP, quantities/realization fail, or no increment versus revenue-only and industry controls after costs.
requiredFields: product-specific price metric and comparison basis

questions.question: Does completed noncore business disposal explicitly funding principal retirement improve subsequent cash economics beyond ordinary low-debt/value exposure?
questions.novelty: A completed issuer cash realization with explicit debt use, not falling asset balances, buybacks, selling-holder secondary offerings or noncash spin distribution. De-risking can lower expected return; no presumed alpha.
questions.entryEvent: First original disclosure confirming completed noncore-business sale, issuer cash proceeds and principal retired using those proceeds. Refinancing/secondary proceeds/noncash distributions do not count; equal balances alone do not prove use of funds.
questions.falsification: Proceeds replace lost operating cash, debt is refinanced not retired, or matched low-debt/value controls explain performance and fees erase any increment.
requiredFields: issuer cash proceeds versus seller proceeds
explicit use for retired debt principal
interest/operating cash lost from sold business
current and PIT share identity/corporate actions
